name: Neon Crucible
difficulty_label: Hard — guided missiles, repairing machines and four uploaded boss bodies
description: Bolt Ironcore’s lost factory floats above an aether-lit abyss. Explore a foundry, signal archive, coolant reactor and uplink; discover repair bays, wake hidden turrets and break Continuum’s four increasingly dangerous bodies. Each upload sends the same intelligence to a distant backup chassis.
